title: French Protests Taper Off as Officials Admit Failure
summary: French officials have rolled out tougher security measures and pledged aid for businesses after cost-of-living protests degenerated into violence, vandalism and looting. Bloomberg's Rosalind Mathieson has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Holds Decline as Energy-Led Inflation Weighs on Rate Path
summary: Gold held a decline, as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns and clouded the Federal Reserve’s path for interest-rate hikes.

title: Mynt’s Record IPO Brings a New Heavyweight to Philippine Stocks
summary: Shares of Mynt Inc. are set to make their debut Tuesday after the biggest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines, potentially giving global investors a new bet in a market they have ignored for years.

title: Asian Stocks Shrug Off US Chip Rally, Oil Steadies: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks opened lower Tuesday, shrugging off a chip-led rebound on Wall Street that helped the Nasdaq 100 recover from its worst week since the tariff turmoil of April 2025.
